label: Короткий / Длинный
description: Practical length contrasts for objects, paths, and actions.

missions.phrase: У меня в руке короткая палка.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Simple noun agreement. 1. 'Короткая' is feminine nominative to match 'палка'. 2. The sentence places the noun in a real situation. 3. This is the basic shape of a length contrast.
Strategic focus: Clear visual contrast. 1. 'Длинная' is feminine nominative agreeing with 'дорога'. 2. The image is easy to picture and reuse. 3. This is a high-value core adjective pair.
Strategic focus: Compact route phrase. 1. 'Короткий' is masculine matching 'путь'. 2. 'Домой' adds a destination and keeps the sentence practical. 3. This is a very natural everyday line.
Strategic focus: Abstract length. 1. 'Длинный' is masculine accusative matching 'рассказ'. 2. Length describes a story, not a physical object. 3. This teaches that length words extend beyond things.

missions.phrase: Это короткая заметка, но длинное письмо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Side-by-side comparison. 1. 'Короткая' is feminine matching 'заметка'. 2. The neuter noun 'письмо' forces 'длинное' to switch form. 3. One contrast drives two different agreements.
Strategic focus: Plural agreement. 'Длинные' takes the plural ending to match 'волосы'. The sentence sets the adjective in a simple personal description.
Strategic focus: Plural agreement. 'Короткие' switches to the plural ending to match 'карандаши'. The verb 'лежат' anchors a concrete desk scene.
Strategic focus: Comparative form. 'Короче' is the comparative of 'короткий' and stays invariant across genders. The sentence compares two routes in plain everyday speech.
Strategic focus: Comparative form. 'Короче' here describes a gradual change in the length of days. The seasonal scene makes the comparative feel natural and memorable.
Strategic focus: Predicative use. 'Длинная' stands after the noun as a predicate describing 'юбка'. 'Слишком' adds a natural everyday judgement about clothing.
